label: rem:confinement-misdp
title: Mixed-integer SDP for integer-rank confinement levels
html:
Remark. Mixed-integer SDP for integer-rank confinement levels

Reading. When operator counts are constrained to integers, the feasible region of the confinement SDP becomes:

  \Phi \succeq 0
  \;\wedge\;
  \mathrm{rank}\text{-content}(\Phi) \in \mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}^{|\mathcal{S}|}.

We solve this Mixed-Integer Semidefinite Program (MISDP) via continuous SDP relaxation combined with branch-and-cut. This strictly matches the confinement framework at every level of the hierarchy.
